units.rawText: I've found you at last. Extending me an invitation through music is something that I would have done.
units.displayText: I've found you at last. Extending me an invitation through music is something that I would have done.

spans.text: I've found you at last. Extending me an invitation through music is something that I would have done.

units.rawText: It would have been best if I could have brought the Professor and Jiangyu over as well. We could have lost ourselves in the music, from the Army-Routing Song to Night-time on the Ocean...
units.displayText: It would have been best if I could have brought the Professor and Jiangyu over as well. We could have lost ourselves in the music, from the Army-Routing Song to Night-time on the Ocean...

spans.text: It would have been best if I could have brought the Professor and Jiangyu over as well. We could have lost ourselves in the music, from the Army-Routing Song to Night-time on the Ocean...

units.rawText: How joyful would it be to invite those dear to our hearts for tea and conversation?
units.displayText: How joyful would it be to invite those dear to our hearts for tea and conversation?

spans.text: How joyful would it be to invite those dear to our hearts for tea and conversation?

units.rawText: That plushie is certainly interesting. If I had not yet come to the Oasis, I would surely have been deeply embarrassed by all this.
units.displayText: That plushie is certainly interesting. If I had not yet come to the Oasis, I would surely have been deeply embarrassed by all this.

spans.text: That plushie is certainly interesting. If I had not yet come to the Oasis, I would surely have been deeply embarrassed by all this.

units.rawText: But things are much different now. There is someone who understands me, even without that plushie.
units.displayText: But things are much different now. There is someone who understands me, even without that plushie.

spans.text: But things are much different now. There is someone who understands me, even without that plushie.

units.rawText: But it's still not enough. I must take the one who is dear to my heart all for myself.
units.displayText: But it's still not enough. I must take the one who is dear to my heart all for myself.

spans.text: But it's still not enough. I must take the one who is dear to my heart all for myself.

units.rawText: (Sigh) It would be bad if that got out. Come, return with me.
units.displayText: (Sigh) It would be bad if that got out. Come, return with me.

spans.text: (Sigh) It would be bad if that got out. Come, return with me.
